interpretation.front_status: Compare each native alpha threshold with x=3.8m; the x-bin fill table separately shows the source and transition region occupancy.

native_branch_partition.limit: The x-bin liquid-volume fraction is a native-cell fill proxy, not an exact normal-plane area fraction. Cell-centre front thresholds are separate metrics.
native_branch_partition.partition_method: native line-zone cells assigned to two volume-weighted (y,z) centroids per 0.1m x bin, initialized from the two allFourValves y bands and propagated bin-to-bin

paired_source_sensitivity.baseline_case: same-mesh compact air-filled dryline baseline; allFourValves source distributed over full nominal 0.30m source zone
qualifications: The thin wet-side arm changes only the declared volumetric fvOptions source support/length normalization. This is not a modeled moving valve disc or a measured seat restriction.
Uniform-field K/L coefficient integral is algebraically preserved by V-band normalization; spatial phase, density, and velocity distributions are intentionally not identical.

The reduced network has a matched compact one-tank/two-branch geometry and downstream-air scope, but uses a centerline wet-feed volume that differs from the native initial line zone by the recorded amount; predictions are consistency comparisons, not validation.
The reduced network has no source-location degree of freedom, so its trajectory is common to both CFD arms and cannot explain their difference.

thin_support.baseline_zone: allFourValves cellZone; x extent approximately [2.10,2.40] m
thin_support.diagnostic_mask: cell-centre x >= 2.15 m and x < 2.25 m, applied within existing allFourValves selected cell list
thin_support.initial_mask_phase: alpha.water=1.0 in every selected band cell, verified against exact baseline initial field/partition
thin_support.normalization: L_eff = 0.30 * V_band / V_zone, preserving the volume-integrated linear coefficient K/L for spatially uniform rho and velocity; no fitting to trajectory
thin_support.qualification: Exploratory numerical sensitivity of source placement/support, not a resolved valve or measured seat model. Uniform-flow equivalence is algebraic only; spatial density/velocity and phase weighting differ intentionally.

paired_source_sensitivity.thin_wet_side_case: matched source-support sensitivity: source restricted to fully wet cell-centre band x=[2.15,2.25)m in allFourValves with volume-normalized effective length

reduced_network_scope.interpretation: Same compact geometry, tank state, air-filled downstream initial condition, and nominal valve law. Interpolated model states use explicit two-sided time brackets; shared pressure/flow agreement is a consistency screen, not independent validation. The ODE does not distinguish source support and its wet-feed line volume differs by the above native/centerline amount.
reduced_network_scope.model_line_scope: current compact one-tank / two-branch candidate, 4.8 m mouth
